lost_requests.why_it_was_lost: Fischer Dental's stream of asks crossed three videos and two channels: 4/26 WhatsApp ('take out the part in why floss matters where I talk about prices'), 4/28 email ('add our phone number at the end of the one we shot last week' — never resolvable to a video), then on 5/6 'Still not fixed on first visit tour. A little frustrated honestly.' The earliest request of the whole year is the template for everything that follows.

Hector's Roofing emailed 5/1 'cut the first 3 seconds of the one we shot last week' — a video name he doesn't give; 74 days later (7/14) he wrote 'Did anyone see my message about storm damage tips? It's not fixed', and on 9/14 had to ask a third time. The vague references were never re-resolved to the actual video on the board.

Trinity Med Spa WhatsApped 5/3 'use our brand color teal on the one we shot last week' — again, no video named; on 7/28 the client concluded 'This is the second time I ask. hydrafacial reveal is still wrong.' WhatsApp input and vague references are the worst combination: neither the request nor the video ever got pinned.

Malik Law WhatsApped on 5/16 'use our brand color navy on divorce timeline' — the request eventually appears as a bare board note ('Brand color navy' on V027) but the video kept being shipped wrong; on 10/4 they escalated 'Divorce timeline still has the same problem. I already told you about this' — 141 days open.

Rosewood Pediatrics emailed 'take out the part in back pain myths where I talk about prices'; on 6/26 'Still not fixed… frustrated', and on 8/20 again asking to blur an unreleased client's face (which only became a bare note 'Blur client face'). Billed via Fieldhouse Marketing, so the world of their feedback lives in a personal inbox that never reaches the board.

Delgado Insurance WhatsApped on 6/16 asking for 'a calmer song' on client story; on 6/28 'Client story still has the same problem. I already told you about this.' The video's board row (V089) has no note about music at all.
Ridgeway Barbershop asked about the sale-promo video on 6/28; on 7/6 they escalated 'Sale promo still has the same problem. I already told you about this.'

Sage Bridal asked about styling tips on 6/29, escalated 7/6, and AGAIN on 7/31 in Spanish — 'Sale promo sigue igual. Ya les había dicho.' (and again 9/28). Spanish-language requests were never acknowledged, so the fix could never close.
Cypress Gym reported 7/23 that the class-schedule video is still wrong; on 8/3 'This is the second time I ask. class schedule is still wrong' — and on 8/22 a third escalation on member story.

The Keystone Lab asked on 7/24 to 'use the other shot, the one outside, not inside' on the bean-origin-story video; on 8/6 'Did anyone see my message about bean origin story? It's not fixed' — the default editor failure-silence had to be broken twice more (9/15 WhatsApp, 9/25 'latte art' repeat).

Fischer's Auto Spa's fix requests were scattered across email (ceramic coating 7/25), Instagram DM (7/26 Tesla detail) and WhatsApp (8/9); none exist on the board for those videos, so on 8/9 Sam had to repeat himself on WhatsApp: 'still has the same problem. I already told you about this.'

Fischer Family Law asked 7/29 about the divorce timeline; on 8/3 'second time I ask. divorce timeline is still wrong', on 9/22 a new repeat about meet-the-attorney, and on 10/4 again — three escalations on the same law firm in one quarter.

lost_requests_root_causes: Requests arrive on 5 channels (email, WhatsApp, Instagram DM, voice note, website form) but there is no single inbox — 5 of the 12 thread examples never even entered a tracked place.
Messages are never linked to a video: only a minority of the 364 board rows carry notes, and requests like 'the one we shot last week' are never resolved to a video_id.
Non-English requests (Spanish) were never translated or acknowledged, so a Sage Bridal fix stayed open for a full quarter with zero action.
There is no closed-loop confirmation — nobody ever replies 'done', and silence hid the same broken video for up to 141 days (Malik Law's navy brand color).
Voice notes and Instagram DMs are invisible to editors sitting in the board spreadsheet; WhatsApp/DM threads were consistently the ones still broken at escalation time.
Agency-billed clients (Fieldhouse's Rosewood + Copperline) have a second layer of indirection — their feedback goes to the agency, not the board.

what_this_data_cannot_tell_us: Whether the payments.csv export is complete — 'no payment on record' could also mean bank transfers that bypassed whatever tool produced this file.
Why leads never replied: first_reply is blank for 14 leads, but we can't see whether the studio never wrote, wrote and bounced, or replied on an untracked channel.

Actual contract terms for retainers — $2,500/month is inferred from consistency across 5 invoices, not from a contract document; INV-1091's $2,250 could theoretically be a negotiated discount (flagged, not assumed as cash still owed).
Ad spend. Channel profit here is cash collected minus studio hours and editor hours. Without ad invoices, Referral could still beat LinkedIn on return on spend.
Which team member failed which step — messages don't say who read and dropped them, and the board doesn't log who updated notes.
Whether the tool's 'paid' figures match a real bank feed; we only have the payments.csv as proxy for the bank.
Whether refunds/chargebacks happened outside this export window (e.g., Vista's $900 duplicate may already have been refunded off-record).
Anything about video quality or creative satisfaction — ratings on the board average ~4.x but there is no survey data behind them.
Declined/lost-lead reasons: leads.csv has a status but no reason field, so 'lost' ≠ 'rejected us' vs 'never answered them'.
